build_transformer_with_simpletransformer: build a transformer model using SimpleTransformer with configurable blocks and attention targets
create_attention_layer: create a multi-head self-attention layer using the Attention class with configurable heads and dropout
build_transformer_block_with_masking: build a transformer encoder block with masking support using BlockWithMasking and layer scaling
create_mlp_feedforward: create a feed-forward MLP layer using the Mlp class with GELU activation and dropout
run_transformer_forward_with_checkpointi: run the SimpleTransformer forward pass with gradient checkpointing to save memory during training
